title: General attach error was timeout (doubled) not unknown-session
body:
John 2026-07-28 follow-up (exact UI copy, general small-tab attach):

This was the error:

Could not attach a live terminal (timeout). The warm view below is still available.Could not attach a live terminal (timeout). The warm view below is still available.

Observations:
- Confirmed reason code is **timeout** (NOT unknown-session).
- Message appeared **twice concatenated** with no separator — same full sentence twice.
- Parent friction: 2026-07-28-05-general-session-small-tab-open-attach-er

Code meaning (facts):
- Client _mountTerminal starts a 5s ackTimer; if attached never becomes true, _attachError("timeout").
- attached only becomes true on replay_complete control frame (WS or SSE).
- unknown-session would say "(unknown-session)" not "(timeout)" — so explicit attach_ack ok:false did NOT fire; handshake simply never completed within 5s.
- Doubled copy strongly suggests TWO mounts both hit the same 5s timeout (dual dock+panel or double _mountTerminal), consistent with 2026-07-25 dual-terminal friction.

Sleep focus shift for Defect 5:
1. Why term_ws / term_stream2 never delivered replay_complete within 5s for a general open (auth hang, WS open-but-silent, SSE never started, server pump stuck, token missing on WS).
2. Why two error overlays / two mounts for one open.
3. Retry after timeout must re-handshake or resume_live — remount-same-id alone still can re-timeout.
